quests.question: Fix: 'Driving to work, the engine suddenly cut out.'

options: As I was driving to work
quests.correctAnswer: As I was driving to work
quests.hint: Who was driving? The engine cannot drive.
quests.explanation: This is a dangling modifier. The opening phrase 'Driving to work' implies a person is driving, but the main subject is 'the engine'. Fix it by adding a subject: 'As I was driving to work, the engine suddenly cut out.'
